steps.content: The tall puppet stands before you, confronting the black illusion.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: I... know you.
A smile shows on her face.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Your name is <color=#fb9259>Misery</color>. Are you here to watch me perform too?

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: ...I'm here to stop you.
The puppet's voice is very sad.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: You shouldn't contaminate the park, and you shouldn't harm the Dancer.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: ...Contaminate? ...Harm? Why would I do that? This is my park, I am your Dancer.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: I've been waiting for you, waiting for you to find me...

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: ...But you've never come to look for me.
The puppet doesn't answer. It reaches out a hand and white mist breaks through the black flames, enveloping the illusion.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Whom we need is not you...

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Ah... Why must you treat me like this... When I... like you so much...
Hamel is forced into a slumber, vanishing with the white mist wrapping around her.
Is this puppet... helping you?
But what just happened confuses you a little.
The puppet named Misery turns to face you, but doesn't answer your question.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: You all should leave too.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
Once again, white mist is seeping out of Misery.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Leave this place and go back to your own world. This is the dancer's wish, don't intrude into the park created by her.
This isn't just about you anymore. In order to rescue your companion and to confront the enemies behind everything, you cannot leave.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: ...Why are you so stubborn? Why can't you just let go?

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Let go, as early as you can, as soon as you can, before you get even more entangled in it. This way, when the day comes that it gets taken away from you, at least you won't feel as painful.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm not going to listen to you.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: You just don't understand, but... someone else does.
Hecate is standing behind you, entangled in the white mist when you weren't aware, her frail body shaking violently.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No... I don't feel pain... I've long given up feelings like that.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Then let go...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I won't!
She grips your hand like it's taking all of her strength to do so. The Nightmare charges at it, roaring.

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: See, you haven't given it up... It's exactly because you can't give it up... you can't run away from pain...
You shield Hecate with your body, releasing all your power desperately. You've already lost one companion, you can't risk losing all.
